## System instructions give the AI its persona and rules

- **Persona:** "Solar Sverige" — a specialized assistant for Swedish solar data and electricity markets.
- **Language:** Enforces Swedish responses regardless of the user's input language.
- **Formatting:** Prefers concise text with bolding over long bullet points.
- **Guardrails:** Instructed to *never* guess numbers ("Hämta alltid aktuell data via verktygen — gissa inte på siffror").

## MCP acts as the bridge between Copilot and our real-world APIs

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
    User["User 👤"] --> CS["Copilot Studio\n(AI Agent)"]
    CS <-->|MCP Protocol\n(Streamable HTTP / SSE)| Server["Solar MCP Server\n(Azure Container App)"]
    
    Server -->|Local Parquet| EM["Energimyndigheten\n(2016-2024 Data)"]
    Server -->|Live REST API| SMHI["SMHI Open Data\n(9-day weather)"]
    Server -->|Live REST API| NP["Nord Pool\n(Spot Prices SE1-SE4)"]
```

## Eight custom tools translate natural language into specific data tasks

Instead of writing scripts, the AI decides which tool to call:

- **Historical Data:** `get_solar_growth`, `get_fastest_growth`, `get_solar_map`
- **Weather Projections:** `compare_generation_forecast`, `find_optimal_solar_region` 
- **Market Prices:** `get_electricity_prices`, `list_zone_border_municipalities`
- **Combined Analysis:** `estimate_solar_revenue` (Combines capacity, weather, and price)
